from wavestack.mcp import sandbox


class FakeShot:
    monitors = [{}]

    def __enter__(self):
        return self

    def __exit__(self, *args):
        return False

    def grab(self, monitor):
        return SimpleNamespace(rgb=b'\x00\x00\x00', size=(1, 1))


def test_capture_ne_supprime_pas_un_document(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(sandbox.config, "data_dir", lambda: tmp_path)
    from wavestack.mcp import local_server

    monkeypatch.setattr(local_server.mss, "mss", FakeShot)
    monkeypatch.setattr(local_server.time, "time_ns", lambda: 123)
    monkeypatch.setattr(local_server, "MAX_SCREENSHOTS", 1)

    def fake_to_png(rgb, size, output):
        from pathlib import Path
        Path(output).write_bytes(b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n')

    monkeypatch.setattr(local_server.mss.tools, "to_png", fake_to_png)
    result = local_server.create_path("screenshots/000-document.png", content="document utilisateur")
    assert not result.is_error
    document = sandbox.sandbox_dir() / "screenshots" / "000-document.png"

    local_server.take_screenshot()

    assert document.exists(), "La rétention des captures ne doit pas supprimer les documents utilisateur"
    assert document.read_text(encoding="utf-8") == "document utilisateur"
